- Bring any network egress/port checklist and a one-page sizing recommendation

- London (CET) team prefers 14:00–17:00 CET
- SF prefers 07:00–10:00 PT (local mornings)
- Tokyo folks are available after 21:00 JST only that week

Can you propose 2–3 concrete slot options in the next 10 days? Also please confirm if daylight saving changes affect anything — our procurement lead is nervous about cross-border times next month.

Thanks,

Proposed slots (all 90-minute, listed with local equivalents):

Option 1 — Wed, 2027-03-10 14:00–15:30 CET (London) / 06:00–07:30 PT (SF) / 23:00–00:30 JST (Tokyo)
Option 2 — Thu, 2027-03-11 15:00–16:30 CET / 07:00–08:30 PT / 00:00–01:30 JST (next day)
Option 3 — Tue, 2027-03-16 13:00–14:30 CET / 05:00–06:30 PT / 21:00–22:30 JST

Notes on each:
- Option 1 is the most balanced for London + SF but late for Tokyo (still within their "after 21:00" window).
- Option 2 shifts things one hour later for EU/SF, Tokyo is borderline midnight.
- Option 3 moves it earlier for APAC and is rough for SF mornings but might be tolerable for early risers.

I've attached a short demo agenda and a network checklist for your infra team to review ahead of time. Sergio and Vivek (copied) will lead the walkthroughs; they can adjust the tech focus if you want more on routing or quantization.

If you confirm a preferred slot I will send calendar invites with Dial-in + Zoom + GMT/UTC times and include a pre-demo checklist.

Best,
